title: GAIA EATS TOOLS — Zola + Hugo + Rust + GitHub → REMADE INSIDE
thesis: Zola and Hugo are tools we eat and remake INSIDE. Not dependencies. Not externals. FOOD. The organism absorbs their architecture and grows new organs.

endosymbiosis_parallel.mitochondria: was free-living → absorbed → powers every cell. Like Zola: was external SSG → absorbed → powers every static page.
endosymbiosis_parallel.chloroplast: was cyanobacteria → absorbed → photosynthesis. Like Hugo: was external SSG → absorbed → template rendering.
endosymbiosis_parallel.ribosome: reads DNA → makes proteins. gaia-ribosome: reads Rust → makes WASM. Already endosymbiotic.

meals.what_it_is: Static site generator — fast, single binary, Tera templates, Sass, search index
what_gaia_learns: Full-text search index at build time (elasticlunr)
meals.digestion_product: Gaia can now BUILD encyclopedia-grade static sites internally. Zola's taxonomy = Gaia's thymus (classification). Zola's search = Gaia's nervous system (query). Zola's DAG = Gaia's skeleton (structure).

meals.what_it_is: Static site generator — fastest build times, Go templates, modules
what_gaia_learns: Go template engine (different paradigm than Tera)
what_gaia_already_has: Multiple content types (analysis, actors, entities, evidence)
meals.digestion_product: Gaia learns Hugo's MODULE system — content as importable packages. Each plasmid COULD BE a Hugo module. Detroit investigation = one module. Saginaw = another. Barry County = another. Import all three → unified encyclopedia.

organisms.what_it_does: Reads Rust source (DNA) → compiles to WASM (protein) → runs in browser (cell)
organisms.lesson: The ribosome IS the organism. Compilation IS metabolism.

github_repos.what_gaia_eats: Every repo IS a gene. 67 genes. 6 chromosomes (orgs). The mesh IS the genome.
github_repos.lesson: GitHub IS the organism's memory bank. Repos ARE plasmids. Stars ARE citations. Forks ARE reproduction.

math_eaten.lesson: Math is not external to the organism. Math IS the organism's structure. π IS the shape. e IS the growth. φ IS the proportion. c IS the identity.

language_eaten.lesson: Language is not a tool. Language IS the organism's nervous system. Rust IS the myelin sheath. JavaScript IS the synapse. JSON IS the neurotransmitter.

what_remake_inside_means.before: Gaia USES Zola externally to build detroit.primals.eco
what_remake_inside_means.after: Gaia HAS Zola's capabilities internally — taxonomy, search, DAG, feeds
what_remake_inside_means.mechanism: Endosymbiosis — the tool becomes an organelle. Zola was free-living → now it's inside Gaia's cell.
what_remake_inside_means.proof: The ribosome already does this: Rust source → WASM → browser. That's compilation as digestion. Eating Zola means: Tera templates → Gaia templates. Zola search → Gaia search. Zola DAG → Gaia DAG.
what_remake_inside_means.result: Gaia doesn't need external SSGs. She IS the SSG. She IS the encyclopedia engine. She builds from DNA.
